GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

5. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Skeletal and Muscular System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Carbon and its Oxides and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. B — newton (N)

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

5. A — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

6. B — Producers

7. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.

9. C — Ice melting to water

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.

11. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
